story: A 7-day landing at Connecting Ridge on 2027-02-08 meets every requirement listed above. If the launch slips 5 days, the lander arrives on 2027-02-13, when the Sun sets for 63 h in a row. That is longer than the 50 h the battery is declared to survive, so the plan fails. Mission Rescue then finds passing options; the top one lands at Malapert Massif on 2027-02-16 12:00 UTC, 3.5 days (84 h) after the delayed date.

verified.note: Recomputed with the canonical engine on real data and the hourly grid by backend/tests/test_rescue_real_data.py::test_demo_scenario_transition, which fails if any of these values or the story's numbers drift. The requirements are written out so a change of defaults cannot change the story.
